description: The Verified PR evidence pack for one pull request: the guard verdict, CI triage, review triage, and Claim Protocol status of the linked issues, in one markdown document where every claim cites its source (check run, review anchor, claim comment URL). Call this when a maintainer, a recruiter, or your future self needs proof, not a summary.

pr_url.description: Full GitHub PR URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123

verify_json.description: Path to a prior `greenlight verify --json` report to include the honest red-green test delta. The pack never runs suites itself.

name: evidence_pack
